A simple little mod to go along with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Furry Overhaul Mod[/url]﻿ made by the community. Just turns Sebastian from a skinny, lovable dork to a pudgy, lovable dork as per the pic. I mean, he sits on his ass moping/programming a lot, and consumes loads of frozen pizzas and Joja Cola, so made sense to me - now your broody wolf can have a bit more cuddle to him. :3

This mod is designed to work with the Content Patcher version of the furry mod. To install, simply drag the files into your mod folder, and agree to the overwrite.

There's also a version of this mod that replaces Seb's cigarette with a much healthier (and tastier) Miner's Treat - you can find that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2344/]here[/url]﻿. There's also an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5101]Ample Alex[/url], if you're so inclined.
